info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Loyalty Loyalty Rules-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Rules Retrieval API allows clients to access and view the defined loyalty rules for a loyalty program. This endpoint provides essential resources and information regarding reward mechanics and eligibility criteria that drive customer engagement and retention. Typical consumers of this API include developers integrating loyalty features into applications, business analysts assessing program performance, and marketers designing promotional campaigns. The data retrieved can help inform strategies for enhancing customer loyalty and program effectiveness.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current loyalty rules applicable to customers. It provides details on how customers can earn and redeem loyalty points.

requestBody.description: Request payload for retrieving loyalty rules. This body must be structured according to the defined schema to ensure successful retrieval of the relevant loyalty information.
